Business Overview:[1][2]
IGSL is in the business of Broking of shares and other securities, Equity/Commodity  Broking, Financing and other related activities. It operates through 224 business locations including branches, franchisees and sub-brokers located across India

pros: Stock is trading at 0.48 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 42.2 to 30.6 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.78% over last 3 years.
